# Kentucky Public Service Commission cases on generation (2026-11-05)

Electric and siting board cases filed 2021 or later whose titles are about generation, a resource plan, a retirement or a large load, plus the hand-checked list. A document's psc.ky.gov/pscecf or pscscf address is a stable public link and can be cited. Copies of documents read are in scopes/us-ky/work/psc/ and are not committed. Public comments are counted, not listed.

## Sources

- Kentucky PSC whole-year case lists: every year from 2021: 2021 (475 cases), 2022 (429 cases), 2023 (418 cases), 2024 (406 cases), 2025 (411 cases), 2026 (318 cases) (https://psc.ky.gov/Case/searchCases/2026)
- Kentucky PSC case filings pages and their Post, Public and Hearings tabs: every key case, up to 10 documents read per case (https://psc.ky.gov/Case/ViewCaseFilings/)
